tnfa.name: TNF-alpha
tnfa.notes: Antibody-dominated: 4,964 references, ~3,100 of them Ig chains or Fvs, plus affibodies, monobodies, miniprotein and receptor-derived decoys. The thresholds in PRESCREEN_SPEC.md were calibrated on this set. Coverage gaps: targets/tnfa/tnfa_coverage_gaps.md

glp1r.name: GLP-1 receptor
glp1r.notes: Peptide-dominated and much smaller than the TNF-alpha set: 225 references, 215 of them GLP-1 analogue peptides from ChEMBL, plus 7 antibody chains and 3 peptide-Fc fusions. WHOLE-SEQUENCE cut points calibrated on this set 2026-10-12 over 442 fixtures: 50/50 knowns caught, zero false positives on 80 unrelated designs and 6 framework-reuse chimeras, and target_known=0.90 sits mid-plateau, so the inherited values hold. The REGION cut point is still inherited untested - only ~10 fixtures and 6 grafts exercise it, because 215 references are peptides with no CDR to compare; strengthening it needs more anti-GLP1R antibody references, not more fixtures. Two coverage limits: 5 references are 5-mers, below both search paths; 94 contain X (non-standard residues from ChEMBL) and match only where the wildcard lands. Expect no_reference_signal on short submissions - below BLIND_LENGTH=25 the filter refuses to call silence a pass.

tfr1.name: Transferrin receptor 1 (TfR1/CD71)
tfr1.notes: 6695 references. Mixed-modality TfR1 set covering the formats the target is actually attacked with: Ig V domains/Fd/scFv, VNAR, VHH, engineered Fc/CH3 patches, Centyrin-type FN3, cystine-dense and bicyclic peptides, designed miniproteins and natural ligands. Non-binders, partner arms, payloads, masks, linkers and wild-type constant regions were removed; mixed constructs were reduced to their TfR-binding module (see derived_from/note in the CSV). 54 references are confirmed binders (structure, reported assay or an INN in Thera-SAbDab), the rest are disclosed binder claims; there are no tested non-binders, because no Proteinbase TfR1 competition has run. Coverage limits: 619 references are under 8 aa and are matched only through the short-reference substring floor (MIN_SUBSTRING_SHORT_REF=6, and only where corpus_occurrences is 0); 203 are under 6 aa and cannot be matched by any arm. The engineered-Fc and Centyrin references depend on the fc_tfr and centyrin scaffold projectors for a paratope - without them an engineered Fc is ~95% identical to wild-type IgG1 Fc on whole sequence and every Fc-bearing submission looks like a known binder. This public copy omits one reference (a Fab whose only source was KEGG DRUG, which does not permit redistribution) and re-attributes five others to their USPTO or JPO records; the internal set carries 6696. Calibrated 2026-10-19 on the full set - this copy plus the one KEGG reference - over 927 fixtures with all eight arms (--per-class 8 --n-unrelated 80): 103/105 verbatim knowns caught (the two misses are 5-aa references), zero target-arm flags on 80 unrelated designs and on 358 PLAbDab germline light chains, and target_known=0.90 sits mid-plateau (knowns flat from 0.86 to 0.94), as does region_match=0.80 (flat from 0.70 to 0.84), so the inherited values hold. known_target_binder at 2/5/10/20/35% mutation: 78/77/51/0/0% (TNF 96/95/54/0/0); the gap at low mutation is light-chain-only references whose CDR-L3 is germline-common, which cannot decide a call - a verbatim copy still does (verbatim_copy). The CDR index is annotated with --near-identity 0.80: without it a patent light chain one edit from the germline QQRSNWPLT made 345 of 358 germline light chains known binders. 6 of 56 framework-reuse chimeras are still called known: 4 are multi-domain hosts the fixture scrambles only one domain of, 1 is an unnumbered VNAR judged on whole sequence (0.91), 1 a Fab at region 0.875.
